label: Blind sample burn 014: MTBS Northline fire, LA, 2022-03-26

verdict.headline: Can't tell
verdict.statement: Burn ratio (NBR) rose by 0.05 relative to the control trajectory in the 6 months after 26 Mar 2022 (90% interval −0.15 to +0.16). The same test was run on 46 untouched control cells. In 2 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.06). Counted by gap size instead, 6 of the 46 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.15). The interval is too wide to rule a meaningful change in or out.
reasons: the interval is too wide to rule a meaningful change in or out

evidence.sentence: Neither optical nor radar shows a change beyond what the controls did.
